svg.metadata: {"story":"Elisha","act":1,"chapter":"Ch.1 · The Mantle","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Elijah finds Elisha ploughing with twelve yoke of oxen; Elisha slaughters his oxen and follows, leaving the plough behind.
